title: Samsung Securities says 3,927 more customers affected by VOC attachment leak, beyond the 8,241 announced on 23 November
date_note: IBTimes UK says Samsung Securities detected signs of the intrusion in its VOC system on Saturday 21 November; Dailysecu (cited for the customer notice) answered 403 at review.
summary: Samsung Securities said on 27 November that the leak of personal data is 3,927 people larger than the 8,241 it announced on 23 November, according to Asia Economy. The leak followed an outsider's access to its VOC (customer complaint) service on 21 November. The company reported the new findings to the relevant agencies and will notify affected customers individually.
plain: Samsung Securities now says 3,927 more customers were affected than the 8,241 it announced on 23 November.
exec: Samsung Securities raised its count of affected customers by 3,927 over its earlier figure of 8,241.
action: Samsung Securities advises customers to check which of their details were compromised via the lookup on its official website and, as relayed by IBTimes UK, to stay alert to phishing scams.
geo_basis: country only; the page read gives no city, pinned at Seoul as the country's capital

evidence.quote: Information on 8,241 clients had been leaked after the firm found unauthorized access to its customer response system, Samsung Securities confirmed.
삼성증권은 최근 해킹으로 인한 개인정보 유출 규모가 총 1만2168명으로 확인됐다고 27일 밝혔다.
이는 개인정보 유출 사실이 확인된 직후인 지난 23일 발표한 8241명에서 3927명 늘어난 규모다.

validation.note: Dailysecu (quoting the customer notice) and The Korea Herald (relaying Yonhap) each state that data of 8,241 Samsung Securities customers leaked after unauthorized access; the notice itself was not found online.

review.note: action advice: voice-phishing/malware-spam advice not on readable pages (Dailysecu 403), narrowed to IBTimes-verified lookup and phishing alert; date_note reworded to IBTimes 21 Nov detection; Korean numeral dropped from summary
